title: ContainerLogger
description: Lightweight Paper 1.21.11 plugin that logs storage block breaks with player names, coordinates, and timestamps.
body:
BlockLogger is a lightweight and optimized Paper 1.21.11 plugin designed to log storage block breaks for server moderation and grief tracking.

The plugin logs:

* Player name
* Block type
* World name
* Exact coordinates
* Date and time

### Supported Blocks

* Chests
* Trapped Chests
* Barrels
* Shulker Boxes
* Ender Chests
* Hoppers
* Furnaces
* Blast Furnaces
* Smokers
* Dispensers
* Droppers

### Features

* Async file logging for better performance
* Configurable block list
* Reload command support
* Bypass permissions
* Lightweight and clean design
* Easy setup

### Permissions

* `blocklogger.reload`
* `blocklogger.bypass`

### Command

* `/blocklogger reload`

### Compatibility

* PaperMC 1.21.11
* Java 21
